title: Harmonization of MODIS and VIIRS Hot Spots

provenance.dataset_name: NASA FIRMS Active Fire Archive (MODIS Collection 6.1 & VIIRS Collection 2)

dataset_identifiers.VIIRS_NOAA21_C2: VJ214IMGTDL_NRT Collection 2 (NOAA-21 / JPSS-2 Active Fire I-Band 375m)

provenance.processing_version: FireHarmonizer-ST-DBSCAN-v2.2 (Anisotropic Elliptical Footprint + Pass-Grouped Bayesian Fusion)
preprocessing_steps: Bounding-box spatial clip [102.0°E–110.0°E, 8.0°N–24.0°N] + geoBoundaries ADM1 ray-casting point-in-polygon join
Laplace confidence clamping [0.05, 0.99] for MODIS (0-100%) and canonical mapping {l: 0.30, n: 0.70, h: 0.95} for VIIRS
Anisotropic elliptical bow-tie footprint matching along cross-track (scan) and along-track (track) axes
Pass-grouped Bayesian log-odds confidence fusion across independent satellite overpasses
Radiative flux-density centroid localization w_i = (FRP_i + 0.1) / max(0.05, scan_i * track_i)

sensors.name: MODIS
sensors.spatial_resolution: 1 km (up to 2.0×4.8 km at swath edge)

key_findings: True Spatio-Temporal DBSCAN (ε = 1.25 km, Δt ≤ 3.0 h with scan/track footprint matching) eliminates 29.17% of redundant raw detections.
Resolves afternoon orbital overlap between Aqua, NOAA-20, and NOAA-21 while preventing artificial 12:00 UTC boundary splits and morning/afternoon false merges.
Refines 85.7% of active fire centroids to 375m ground precision via FRP-weighted VIIRS localization.
Identifies 12 dual-sensor (MODIS+VIIRS) and 120 multi-satellite corroborated fire fronts with independent pass Bayesian confidence fusion.
Reconciles Fire Radiative Power (FRP) per satellite overpass before cross-sensor maximization, preventing double-counted radiative energy across NOAA-20 and NOAA-21.
